title: Sei, Beluga and Seqweaver
lead: Sei, Beluga and Seqweaver predict how variants, regions or sequences change regulatory activity (Sei, Beluga) or RNA-binding protein targets (Seqweaver), using one shared form and one shared result page.

pairs.caption: The Sei form with the example VCF loaded
pairs.input: Sei, GRCh37/hg19, Variants (VCF), the example file

pairs.caption: Sei result: variant scores plot and table
Selected variant in the genome browser
pairs.input: Same Sei job, variant chr7:49,813,589 G>C chosen from the table

pairs.caption: Molecular effects heatmap for the selected variant
pairs.input: Same Sei job and variant, Heatmap tab, sequence class score

differences.existing: Seqweaver form lives at /seqweaver-deepsea; /seqweaver is a gnomAD RBP effects browser
differences.proposed: /seqweaver is the form; /seqweaver-deepsea is a 404 and there is no gnomAD browser
differences.evidence: Analyses menu on humanbase.io links Seqweaver to /seqweaver-deepsea; humanbase.io/seqweaver/ shows the gnomAD browser; humanbase-frontend.pages.dev/seqweaver-deepsea/ says Page not found; apps/web/src/routes.tsx:46-51

differences.existing: Shown but disabled; fixed to the page's tool
differences.proposed: Enabled; choosing another model opens that tool's page
differences.evidence: #formDeepSEAModel isDisabled true on /sei/, /beluga/, /seqweaver-deepsea/; packages/hb/src/VariantJobForm/VariantJobForm.tsx:101, apps/web/src/pages/deepsea/DeepseaPage.tsx:18

differences.existing: Type dropdown: VCF, BED, FASTA
differences.proposed: What are you submitting? Variants (VCF), Regions (BED), Sequences (FASTA)
differences.evidence: Type options read on all three existing forms; VariantJobForm.tsx:116-121

differences.existing: Genome assembly stays visible for FASTA
differences.proposed: Genome assembly is hidden for FASTA; hg19 is still sent
differences.evidence: Existing form keeps Genome assembly after choosing FASTA; VariantJobForm.tsx:102 and DeepseaService.ts:46. Ask: does the API use genome_assembly for FASTA jobs?

differences.existing: Example VCF submission puts the example text in an editable Submission box
differences.proposed: Use the example shows example.vcf as a file card with a summary; editing means Paste
differences.evidence: Textarea readOnly false on humanbase.io; capture pair 1; VariantJobForm.tsx:84-90, 134-147

differences.existing: One shared set: example.vcf, example_strand.vcf, example.bed, example.fasta (one FASTA for all tools)
differences.proposed: About panel lists example.vcf, .bed and .fasta per tool; FASTA sized for that tool; Seqweaver's VCF and BED carry a strand
differences.evidence: Example files links point to s3 .../deepsea/examples/ on all three existing forms; DeepseaForm.tsx:70-92

differences.existing: No check seen before Submit (not tested, to avoid starting jobs)
differences.proposed: Checks the file in the browser: counts, line problems, wrong type, up to 20,000 variants; Run button names the count
differences.evidence: VariantJobForm.tsx:69-72, 149; packages/data/src/jobs/VariantFileCheck.ts:26, 39-42. Ask: what limits does the API enforce, and is 20,000 right?

differences.existing: Example VCF has a sixth strand column (+ or -)
differences.proposed: Strand column is required for Seqweaver VCFs; a missing strand blocks Run
differences.evidence: Existing Seqweaver example lines end in - or +; VariantFileCheck.ts:85-88. Ask: does the API require the strand or default it?

differences.existing: Opt-in to stay up to date with our newsletter appears after an email is typed
differences.proposed: No opt-in on the form; signup is always sent as false (footer has Subscribe)
differences.evidence: Checkbox appeared after filling the email on humanbase.io/sei/; packages/data/src/deepsea/DeepseaService.ts:38

differences.existing: New sequence model notice with links to the Sei code repository and the bioRxiv manuscript
differences.proposed: Summary line only; no repository or manuscript links
differences.evidence: Links github.com/FunctionLab/sei-framework and biorxiv 2021.07.29.454384 on humanbase.io/sei/; no match for sei-framework in the repo

differences.existing: After Submit, a Recent Sei jobs panel under the form shows status and View Results; kept in localStorage for 24 hours
differences.proposed: Opens a job page with steps (Submitted, Queued, Running, Results ready); job kept in the Jobs menu with no expiry in code
differences.evidence: Seen after one accidental submission on humanbase.io/sei/; existing bundle stores deepsea_job_ keys with a 24 h cutoff; DeepseaJobView.tsx:16-21, DeepseaForm.tsx:44

differences.existing: Result page shows the submitter's email address
differences.proposed: Result page does not show the email
differences.evidence: humanbase.io/deepsea/jobs/a5de3bd5-f4e6-4201-8f88-5bbe1931c094/ shows a@b.org; DeepseaResultView.tsx:78-83

differences.existing: Variant effect predictions, created date and model; no title shown when Untitled
differences.proposed: Job title with Rename and Copy link; Model, Genome, Variants and Submitted labels
differences.evidence: Capture pair 2; DeepseaResultView.tsx:74-91

differences.existing: Download results is one link to the job's tar.gz
differences.proposed: Download results menu lists each file: per-feature TSVs, the variant score bigWig, the uploaded query and the archive
differences.evidence: Existing link to s3 .../<id>.tar.gz; proposed menu on the Sei job shows 5 items; DeepseaResultView.tsx:88

differences.existing: Score type lists Max sequence class score and each of the 40 sequence classes
differences.proposed: Score lists only Max sequence class score
differences.evidence: Existing dropdown read on job 2e18fedf; proposed combobox has one option; DeepseaModel.ts variantScores ['seqclass']

differences.existing: Color style: Chromosome or Sequence class (Sei only)
differences.proposed: Color style: Chromosome or Sequence class (Sei only), with humanbase.io's 24 chromosome colors and eight group colors, and a legend above the plot
differences.evidence: Color style dropdown on Sei job only, not on Beluga 8b26a498 or Seqweaver 76aea8fe; point colors compared one by one with job 2e18fedf; DeepseaResultView.tsx

differences.existing: Plot style: Manhattan or Score Rank; overview strip under the plot
differences.proposed: Plot style: Manhattan or Score Rank, laid out as humanbase.io lays it out; overview strip with chromosome bands, a brush and mouse-wheel zoom; arrow keys, Enter and + and - on the points
differences.evidence: Point positions, tick labels and overview bands compared one by one with job 2e18fedf at a 1,100px plot on October 22, 2026 (ScorePlotLayout.test.ts); VariantScorePlot.tsx

differences.existing: Separate Table tab: every score as a column (40 classes for Sei), search, Chr filter, Show data in genomic range
differences.proposed: Table beside the plot: variant, gene and top class, one score column (two for Beluga and Seqweaver), filter by name or position, first 9 then Show all
differences.evidence: Existing headers read from the Sei Table tab; proposed table on all three jobs; DeepseaResultView.tsx:122-174. Ask: are the Chr filter and genomic range filter needed?

differences.existing: Choosing a table row moves the genome browser; selection is not in the URL
differences.proposed: Plot, table, Previous and Next all select; the variant is kept in the URL as ?variant=
differences.evidence: Row click moved existing browser to 7:49,763,588..49,863,590 with the URL unchanged; proposed URL ?variant=chr7-49813589-G-C; apps/web/src/pages/deepsea/DeepseaJobPage.tsx:13

differences.existing: Opens at 1:2,230,000..2,440,000 until a variant is picked, then 100 kb around it
differences.proposed: Opens on the selected variant with 50 kb either side (100 kb), as today, with a marker
differences.evidence: Seen on job 2e18fedf before and after a row click; capture pair 3; job 76aea8fe reads 1:109767590:109867590 on load; DeepseaResultView.tsx startWidth

differences.existing: Variant score track (such as Max sequence class score) plus GENCODE 19; add track, print and settings buttons
differences.proposed: Position, sequence and GENCODE 19 genes only; no score track or track actions
differences.evidence: Capture pair 3; VariantGenomeBrowser.tsx:19, 70, 83

differences.existing: Two tabs: Heatmap and Sequence classes (Features for Beluga and Seqweaver)
differences.proposed: Three tabs: Strongest effects (new, with 0.5, 1, 2 or All thresholds), Heatmap and All features
differences.evidence: Tabs read on all three jobs; EffectsCard.tsx:70-104

differences.existing: Top 20 of 40, Full or Compact, Reverse sort; columns numbered across the browser range
differences.proposed: Top 20 of 40, Full or Compact rows, Lowest first, Show more; one column for the selected variant
differences.evidence: Capture pair 4; EffectsCard.tsx:84-95. Ask: should the heatmap show every variant in the browser range, as the existing axis suggests?

differences.existing: Continuous blue to red, -6 to 6, for Sei
differences.proposed: Binned blue to brown at 0.5, 1 and 2 for Sei; z-score bins 2, 3, 5 for Beluga and Seqweaver
differences.evidence: Capture pair 4 legends; DeepseaModel.ts bins; DeepseaResultView.tsx:45-48

differences.existing: Sei: Sequence class score, Probability diffs. Beluga and Seqweaver: z-score, e-value, Probability diffs
differences.proposed: Same options in the Score field of molecular effects
differences.evidence: Dropdowns read on jobs 2e18fedf, 8b26a498, 76aea8fe on both sites

differences.existing: A book icon beside Score type and beside the heatmap legend opens the model's docs at #output
differences.proposed: A Score type documentation link beside the plot's Score and the molecular effects' Score opens the same page
differences.evidence: Links read on jobs 2e18fedf (sei.html#output), 8b26a498 (beluga.html#output), 76aea8fe (seqweaver.html#output), e504e3cc (expecto.html#output)
